item.title: Advanced Solutions for Handling Corrosive Chemicals with Lined Pumps
item.description:
Engineered Protection: Lined Pumps for Corrosive and Hazardous Chemicals
#

Lined pumps are specifically designed to address the challenges of transferring highly aggressive and corrosive chemicals. By combining an external metallic armor with a lining of advanced fluorinated engineering plastics, these pumps deliver both structural strength and exceptional chemical resistance. The magnetic drive, seal-less construction further ensures leak-free operation, making them ideal for industries where safety and reliability are paramount.

item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for Chemical Handling and Pumping Applications
item.description:
Engineered Chemical Pumping Solutions for Industry Needs
#

ASSOMA specializes in the design and manufacture of sealless centrifugal magnetic drive pumps, chemical filters, and system accessories tailored for the safe handling of aggressive and hazardous chemicals. Our expertise enables us to deliver custom solutions that address the specific requirements of various industries, including electronics, chemical processing, environmental engineering, and energy sectors.
